title: HEADHUNTING PROGRAM UPDATE
lines: First and foremost, we would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude for your unwavering dedication to Arknights. Your boundless passion and exceptional creativity have played an instrumental role in elevating the game’s popularity and credibility to unprecedented heights.

For over three years, the Head Hunting Program has been a cornerstone of our community, welcoming outstanding content creators whose remarkable works have enriched the Arknights experience for players worldwide. To honor your incredible contributions and support your continued growth, we are excited to introduce an upgraded Head Hunting Program.

This enhanced initiative is designed to empower you further, fuel your creativity, and foster a thriving ecosystem for content creators. Together, we aim to build a diverse and harmonious community where talents shine, knowledge is shared, and high-quality content reaches Arknights players globally. Your participation is essential to realizing this vision, and we invite you to join us in shaping the next chapter of creative excellence!
-Opportunity to collaborate officially with the Arknights EN team；
-Access to exclusive HD materials and priority support；
-Customized gift packs tailored to your contributions
To ensure the quality and integrity of our community, applicants must meet the following criteria:
-At least 3 Arknights-related videos published in the past 3 months, with a combined total of 600+ views.
-At least 2 Arknights-related streams in the past 2 months, with a combined total of 600+ views.
-All content must be 100% original. Any violation will result in immediate disqualification.
-Content must not include political, violent, pornographic, grotesque material; controversial topics or restricted themes as defined by the platform; or copyright-infringing materials.
To apply for the program, please complete the following application form: https://forms.gle/HdvAtmLwxC2SQbgt7
-Proof of Channel Ownership (e.g., a screenshot of your channel homepage)
1. All applications will undergo a review process. Failure to meet any requirements will result in disqualification.
2. Applicants will be notified of results via the email address provided. Successful applicants will receive an invitation email with further details.
3. By applying, you certify that all information provided is truthful and accurate. Arknights EN will not be held responsible for issues arising from inaccurate or incomplete information.
If you have any questions about the Head Hunting Program, please feel free to reach out to us at arknights.en.hh@yo-star.com .
Thank you for your continued support and interest in the Arknights community. We look forward to receiving your application and embarking on this exciting journey together!
